covers: US session and PCE inflation data on Wed 25 Nov 2026, the JSE close on Wed 25 Nov after Prosus and Naspers results, and overnight news to Thu 26 Nov 2026
headline: US inflation stays hot and a December Fed hike is fully priced; S&P puts Nvidia's AA rating on watch for a cut; Naspers and Prosus fall about 4% after results
summary: In South Africa, Naspers fell 4.35% to R611.16 and Prosus 4.26% to R571.90 on Wednesday after their half-year results, while Clicks rose 4.23% (LRC Stock Scanner, 25 Nov 2026). In the US, the Dow erased an intraday fall of more than 1,100 points to close up 0.33% at 50,183, while the S&P 500 slipped 0.21% to 7,186 and the Nasdaq fell 0.62% to 23,586 after core PCE inflation rose 0.3% for a third month (Motley Fool, 25 Nov 2026). Gold dropped as much as 2% to $3,483.59, its lowest in more than a year, as markets fully priced a December Fed hike (Reuters via Kitco, 25 Nov 2026); US markets are closed today for Thanksgiving, and the Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa are due late on Friday.

items.title: S&P puts Nvidia's AA credit rating on watch for a possible downgrade
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia's 'AA' rating on CreditWatch negative on Wednesday, saying the departure and reinstatement of CEO Jensen Huang exposed weaknesses in management and board oversight. It could downgrade within 90 days and expects any cut to be limited to one notch. Moody's said its Aa1 rating and stable outlook are unaffected. Nvidia closed down nearly 4% on Wednesday and is down 38% since 6 October (Reuters via Investing.com, 25 Nov 2026).

items.title: US PCE inflation rises 0.3%; markets fully price a December Fed hike
items.summary: The PCE price index rose 0.3% in October after an unrevised 0.5% gain in September, and markets have fully priced in a rate hike at the Fed's December meeting, according to CME FedWatch. The Fed last raised rates in September (Reuters via Kitco, 25 Nov 2026). Core PCE rose 0.3% for a third straight month (Motley Fool, 25 Nov 2026).

items.title: Dow erases 1,100-point loss to close up 0.33%; S&P 500 and Nasdaq end lower
items.summary: On Wednesday the Dow closed at 50,183 (+0.33%), the S&P 500 at 7,186 (-0.21%) and the Nasdaq at 23,586 (-0.62%), well off their lows as tech and AI shares stayed under pressure and energy led the sectors. HP rose 11.49% after beating earnings forecasts and giving an encouraging fiscal 2027 outlook; Ambarella fell 19.77% on weak guidance. The 10-year Treasury yield eased to 4.91% (Motley Fool, 25 Nov 2026).

items.title: US markets closed today for Thanksgiving; early close on Friday
items.summary: Wall Street is shut on Thursday 26 Nov and closes early on Friday 27 Nov, so US-listed prices will not update until Friday.

items.title: Naspers and Prosus fall about 4% after results; Clicks and BAT gain
items.summary: On Wednesday Naspers closed 4.35% lower at R611.16 and Prosus 4.26% lower at R571.90 after reporting a 27% fall in first-half profit from continuing operations alongside a 12% rise in adjusted EPS. Clicks rose 4.23% to R206.40 and British American Tobacco 3.18% to R1,043, while Anglo American fell 1.57% and Glencore 2.10% (LRC Stock Scanner, JSE close 25 Nov 2026).

items.title: Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa due late on Friday 27 Nov
items.summary: Both agencies have South Africa on positive outlooks; the decisions are expected after the JSE close on Friday. The rand was last at about R17.63 per dollar early on Wednesday, before the US data (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 25 Nov 2026).

items.title: Gold hits more than one-year low after US inflation data; silver and platinum fall
items.summary: At 16:15 SAST on Wednesday spot gold was down 2% at $3,483.59 an ounce, its lowest since September 2025 and about 37% below this year's record; silver fell 3.8% to $39.33 and platinum 2.7% to $1,241.67 (Reuters via Kitco, 25 Nov 2026). Gold later recovered some ground, quoted at $3,572.40 (+0.29%) at the US close (Motley Fool, 25 Nov 2026).
items.source: Reuters via Kitco; Motley Fool, 25 Nov 2026

items.title: Brent back above $90; copper up 2%
items.summary: Brent crude ended Wednesday at $90.27 a barrel and WTI at $83.54, with attacks on shipping near the Strait of Hormuz keeping supply worries alive; copper rose 2.0% to $5.47 a pound (LRC Forex & Commodities scan, Yahoo Finance daily prices, 25 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nvidia on S&P downgrade watch, shares down about 4% (LRC rating HOLD)
items.summary: Nvidia closed at $149.30, down 3.91% on Wednesday (LRC Stock Scanner, 25 Nov 2026), as S&P flagged governance risk after Jensen Huang's exit and return (Reuters via Investing.com, 25 Nov 2026). The LRC Stock Scanner rating is HOLD; this note does not change it.

items.title: Naspers and Prosus sell off after results (LRC rating HOLD for both)
items.summary: Both shares fell more than 4% on results day, to R611.16 and R571.90 (LRC Stock Scanner, 25 Nov 2026). Adjusted EPS growth of 12% was within guidance, but cash flow before the Tencent dividend was negative as iFood spending rose (Investing.com, 25 Nov 2026). The HOLD ratings are not changed by this note.

items.title: HP jumps 11.49% on an earnings beat (LRC rating HOLD)
items.summary: HP rose 11.49% to $31.15 after better-than-expected quarterly earnings and an encouraging fiscal 2027 outlook (Motley Fool; LRC Stock Scanner, 25 Nov 2026). The LRC Stock Scanner rating is HOLD, unchanged by this note.
